conventions.position: Base link-origin world position minus original reference positions plus environment origin; no per-episode fitting or removal of reset position error. Reference linearly interpolated at physical control time frame/50+.02. Full-cycle RMSE excludes final sample beyond reference horizon3.38s.
conventions.velocity: World base COM velocity rotated from telemetry; liftoff/landing values interpolated from20ms control samples; peaks are20ms sampled, not5ms exact.
conventions.landing: Contact times from analysis.json; landing X error at each actual landing time; averages include five complete cycles only.
conventions.late_wheels: Reference command phase>=1.85s, first50Hz frame1.86;5ms physics data, only complete cycles, left/right pooled RMS.
conventions.comparison: Three8192-env server policies; no_height=Nov7 full-wheel/height0/std.30, height=Nov6 height2/no-wheel/std.30, current=Nov8 height2/late-wheel/std.15. Multiple reward changes; not a single-factor causal experiment.
